{{Quote|Stopping Malgus will keep the Republic safe. We needed something to push our investigation forward. And I think I found it.|[[Tau Idair]], to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Barus Rava|Rava]]|<ref name="TOR:OW" />}}
During the [[Third Galactic War]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tau Idair]] and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Rivix]] '''dueled''' in [[Darth Nul]]'s [[Darth Nul's archive|archive]]. Idair eventually escaped with [[Darth Nul's lightsaber]] and brought it back to [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="TOR:OW" />
